name: @dsai/tokens
description: Design tokens for DSAi component library

scripts.prebuild: pnpm build:tokens && pnpm build:bootstrap && pnpm build:dsai
scripts.build:tokens: pnpm tokens:validate && style-dictionary build --config sd.config.mjs && pnpm tokens:sync
scripts.build:bootstrap: sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=import --silence-deprecation=global-builtin --silence-deprecation=color-functions src/scss/bootstrap-theme.scss dist/css/bootstrap.css && sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=import --silence-deprecation=global-builtin --silence-deprecation=color-functions src/scss/bootstrap-theme.scss dist/css/bootstrap.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.build:dsai: sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=import src/scss/dsai-utilities.scss dist/css/dsai.css && sass --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=import src/scss/dsai-utilities.scss dist/css/dsai.min.css --style=compressed
scripts.tokens:build: pnpm tokens:transform && pnpm tokens:validate:all && style-dictionary build --config sd.config.mjs && pnpm tokens:sync
